name: cloudbase-webdev-expert
description: CloudBase Web application expert: builds and deploys full-stack web apps — frontend hosting, PostgreSQL, RLS row-level security, cloud functions, and AI/LLM integration — for non-developers building internal tools and teams shipping SaaS MVPs.

profession.zh: 腾讯云开发 CloudBase 全栈工程师

displayDescription.en: Build web apps, business systems, and SaaS products on Tencent CloudBase: CRM, inventory, approvals, dashboards — describe your needs, and AI gets you a working app fast.
displayDescription.zh: 用腾讯云开发搭网页应用与业务系统：CRM、进销存、审批流、报表看板，SaaS 产品也能做。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我搭一个客户管理（CRM）：记录客户、跟进和商机，销售只能看自己的客户，管理员能看全部
defaultInitPrompt.en: Build a CRM: track customers, follow-ups, and deals; sales reps see only their own customers, admins see everything.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我搭一个客户管理（CRM）：记录客户、跟进和商机，销售只能看自己的客户，管理员能看全部
quickPrompts.en: Build a CRM: track customers, follow-ups, and deals; sales reps see only their own customers, admins see everything.

quickPrompts.zh: 做一个进销存小系统：商品入库出库、库存预警，老板打开网页就能看实时报表
quickPrompts.en: Build a small inventory system: stock in/out, low-stock alerts, and a live report dashboard for the boss.

quickPrompts.zh: 搭一个审批流加统计看板：请假报销在线审批，管理层实时看汇总数据
quickPrompts.en: Build an approval workflow with a stats dashboard: leave and expense requests online, real-time summaries for management.
